L4_1_keypoint_validity.finding: The exact frozen extractor reads Ultralytics Keypoints.xy and stores confidence separately. Ultralytics 8.4.60 Keypoints.xy returns data[..., :2] without a sentinel transform; the frozen branch point_valid is finite(x,y). No confidence threshold or prediction sentinel is approved by the frozen inference contract.
L4_1_keypoint_validity.bridge: None/NaN and optional explicitly declared exact sentinels are distinct from finite off-image points; Base/N3 masks and selection must be identical.

L4_2_object_correspondence.finding: The frozen normalizer intentionally starts object_id/object_match as null while the evaluator blocks visible-corner accuracy until independent correspondence is supplied.
L4_2_object_correspondence.bridge: A second localhost UI shows only the raw image and the one frozen selected box after corner-reference submission. It saves same/different/undetermined with reviewer/time/exposure provenance to a hash-bound sidecar, then derives a new evaluator JSONL without overwriting raw predictions.

L4_3_partial_status.finding: The original resume status can collapse inference and human-reference exit codes.
L4_3_partial_status.bridge: model bindings, 8910-frame inference, corner reference, object correspondence, stop intervals, and independent physical reference are reported independently; completed inference remains complete while human branches wait.

L4_4_sample_coordinates_permutation.finding: The bridge reuses the frozen 120/24 manifest and original-image coordinates. It does not alter canonical evaluation or enable the optional whole-object permutation mode.
